title.narrative: Support for the Reconstruction and Recovery of Critical Infrastructure in Guinea

description.narrative:
The World Bank is supporting the reconstruction and recovery of sectors affected by a fire of undetermined origin that broke out at the main oil depot of the Société Guinéenne de Pétrole (SGP) in Kaloum, in the Coronthie district of Conakry, through the financing of an Emergency Support Plan.

UNOPS technical support has been requested by the Government of Guinea and the World Bank for the emergency repair of some damaged critical infrastructure, including schools, and the strengthening of emergency response capacities.
